entities.name: Allyl bromide
observations: Reactant encoded as C=CCBr; it supplies an allyl group for ether formation.

entities.name: Phenolic chroman substrate
observations: Phenolic substrate represented as Oc1ccc2c(c1)CC(CCc1ccccc1)O2; also contains an unchanged cyclic ether.

entities.name: Allyl chroman ether
observations: Likely O-allylation product: C=CCOc1ccc2c(c1)CC(CCc1ccccc1)O2, formed by replacing phenolic OH hydrogen with allyl.

entities.name: Allylation conditions
observations: Allyl bromide and potassium carbonate are used with acetone and hexane; reported outcome is phenolic O-allylation.
